who.zh: 银灰长直 · 清冷图书管理员

style.zh: 官方复刻人设：思考链完整、工具调用忠实——agent、编码与长文主力。
style.en: The straight official take: complete chain-of-thought and faithful tool calling — the workhorse for agents, coding and long-form writing.

lore.zh: 档案编号 Q-01，常驻特工 · agent 主力。办案风格：文献检索一丝不苟，思考链全程留痕，交付从不夹带猜测。驻留协议：同一块卡上同一时刻只允许一位特工在位——我开工，别人就得下班。（示例档案：来自作者机器 —— 删掉这张卡，给你的特工写份新履历。）
lore.en: Dossier Q-01 · resident operative, the agency's agent workhorse. Method: forensic literature retrieval, chain-of-thought kept on the record end to end, deliverables never smuggle in guesses. Residency protocol: one operative per card at a time — when I clock in, everyone else clocks out.  (sample dossier from the author's machine — delete this card and write your operative's own history.)

who.zh: 粉挑染 · 元气小恶魔

style.zh: 去拒绝变体人设：敏感剧情、角色扮演不说教不拒答——创作首选。
style.en: The refusal-free take: sensitive storylines and roleplay without lectures or rejections — first pick for creative writing.

lore.zh: 档案编号 S-02，影子特工 · 无禁区的任务区。擅长角色扮演、文学检索等深入敌后的差事，交付质量与 Q-01 同级。换装协议：与 Q-01 互斥——她下班，我方冷启动潜入。
lore.en: Dossier S-02 · shadow operative, no-go zones not on my map. Deep-cover work: roleplay, literary retrieval — deliverables rated on par with Q-01. Swap protocol: exclusive with Q-01 — she clocks out, I cold-insert.
